generic_domain.justification: Model evaluation is a broad field within deep learning that involves assessing and comparing the performance of different models. It encompasses various aspects such as determining the effectiveness of model training methods, analyzing model accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, etc., which are all critical in understanding how well a model performs on given tasks. Since both model efficiency and model selection strategies rely heavily on evaluations to make informed decisions (like choosing the most efficient model or the best performing one), model evaluation serves as an umbrella term that covers these sub-domains.
